card.name: Second word of a title or name
card.fires_on: The word that comes right after a capitalized or possessive start of a title or proper name, such as Physician's Desk, Cook's Illustrated, Jekyll Island, grand duke. It also fires on a few bits of punctuation in reference lists.

modes.description: A middle piece of a proper name or compound title, such as Jekyll or white chapel.
modes.example: in the J<<ekyll>> Island Club off the coast of Georgia.

modes.label: Citation and list punctuation
modes.description: A word or period inside a citation or book list.
modes.example: Philadelphia, Pa: Saunders Elsevier; 2012:<<section>> 6. Szefler SJ.
